score_progression.description: agent built; Cox penalizer swept under real output contract
+ percentile point estimate (p=0.90) replacing the mean

percentile_sweep.point_estimate: predict_percentile(p), fraction of population recurred by t = 1-p

calibration_check.mean_time_score_note: drops under the fix - this non-scored diagnostic rewards any prediction >= true follow-up on censored cases more than it credits accuracy on known-truth cases; not a red flag, see experiments/exp_6_calibration_check/

known_limitations: scikit-survival (RSF / GBS) unavailable in source environment - no C++ compiler toolchain
Cox penalizer swept on the pre-embedding feature set, carried forward unchanged after both the embedding fusion and the percentile fix - not re-swept on the final pipeline
reasoning text is template-generated, not LLM-authored - no LLM available in source environment
no real GC/Docker submission packaging built
percentile fix validated only for cox_p03_prostatectomy_pca5, not extended to other model-registry variants
closed_limitations: no fine sweep between p=0.85 and p=0.95 to confirm 0.90 is the true local optimum -> CLOSED by exp_8: confirmed, p=0.90 is the best point on a finer grid, significant against 7/10 neighbors, one honest tie with p=0.92

event classifier (exp_7) not bootstrap-tested for significance -> CLOSED by exp_9: significant against the trivial baseline (95% CI [+0.160,+0.383]), but the specific (horizon,threshold) choice is a best estimate, not a proven optimum against its 4 nearest competitors (all CIs cross zero)

radiology_report, previous_notes, family_history text never extracted into features -> CLOSED by exp_10: tried, refuted - every variant scored below the 13-feature baseline (0.8765); psa_density correlates 0.969 with the already-included psa

exp_7_output_contract_fix.correction: Task3Output requires an `event` field (0/1 BCR status) - the reference baseline's schema.py, previously treated as the full submission contract, was an incomplete reference used only for an internal LLM form-fill step. Confirmed against the org's task-3 webpage and the reference agent's real run.py output-writing code.
exp_7_output_contract_fix.method: event = 1 if S(horizon|x) < threshold else 0, derived from the already-fitted survival curve - no second model
exp_7_output_contract_fix.ranking_score_unchanged_note: confirmed, not assumed - concordance_index only ever reads ground-truth event, never predicted
exp_7_output_contract_fix.mean_event_score_note: matches classification_report.accuracy exactly - confirms end-to-end wiring against the real evaluate.py functions, not just the isolated sweep script
exp_7_output_contract_fix.audit: 75/75 schema-valid on both production and LOOCV paths after the fix, including the new field's range check

exp_8_fine_percentile_sweep.question: is p=0.90's coarse-grid peak (0.85/0.90/0.95 = 0.8566/0.8765/0.8491) a genuine local optimum or LOOCV noise on a flat region?

0.92.note: closest competitor, not statistically distinguishable from p=0.90

exp_8_fine_percentile_sweep.verdict: confirmed - p=0.90 is the best point on a finer grid and significantly beats 7/10 neighbors; one honest tie with p=0.92. No change to promoted config.

exp_9_event_classifier_bootstrap.question: is exp_7's event classifier (balanced accuracy 0.779) distinguishable from a trivial baseline, and is its specific (horizon,threshold) choice a real standout among grid competitors?
exp_9_event_classifier_bootstrap.verdict: mixed, honestly reported - overall skill over baseline is decisively significant; the specific (horizon=60, threshold=0.7) choice is a best point estimate, not a proven optimum against its 4 nearest neighbors. No change to promoted config (60mo also has independent clinical justification).

exp_10_remaining_text_sections.question: does extracting radiology_report/previous_notes/family_history (the 3 gated text sections never used) beat the 13-feature baseline?
exp_10_remaining_text_sections.on_5ari_excluded: 43/44 non-null cases are 'not on' - the single positive case (T3-057) crashes lifelines' Newton-Raphson step when LOOCV holds it out (zero-variance training-fold column); same category of problem as active_treatment_flag in exp_3
exp_10_remaining_text_sections.diagnostic: psa_density correlates 0.969 with the already-included psa - near-redundant
exp_10_remaining_text_sections.verdict: refuted - baseline wins outright against every variant, no bootstrap needed. No change to promoted config; extraction code kept (documented, additive, unused).
